utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, are we sure everything's ready? I thought we still needed some supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Pia, what supplies do you think we're missing? I know it's at 123 Oak Street at 9 AM, but I want to make sure we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I heard Leo fixed something, but I'm not sure what. And do we have all the tools we need, like screwdrivers and wrenches?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive on Saturday. Need any tools from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, bring your socket set and a multimeter if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I'll grab those from the shed and bring them along on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at 42 Cherry Lane from 9 to 4, and we could use all the help we can get!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I thought it was at the park near the playground this Saturday at 9 AM. Is it at 42 Cherry Lane instead?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it's definitely at 42 Cherry Lane from 9 to 4. Maybe the park was for something else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, Oren, it's both! We're fixing appliances and park benches this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right. I've been out of the loop lately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Uli! We could use an extra pair of hands if you're free Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Bo, you coming to the repair drive Saturday? We're fixing all sorts of stuff, from toasters to bikes!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, I heard something about that. Saturday morning at Leo's, right? I might drop by with a broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Actually, it's at the community center, not Leo's! And starts at 9 AM. See you there with that lamp?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community event where we fix broken items together. Saturday at 9 AM at 123 Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought I heard it was at the community center on Elm Street—is that right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive is on Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4. Are you interested in helping out?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, I think there's a mix-up. The repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at my garage, 123 Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, sorry for the confusion! I must have mixed up the details. Saturday at your garage at 9 AM—I can be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, so it's Sunday? I might come by later then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, Saturday at 9? Got it. I'll try to make it after my morning errands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all meeting at the community center from 10 to 4 to fix stuff—bring anything that's broken!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've got it on my calendar. Community center, 10 to 4 this Saturday. I'm ready to help with fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Opal! Do you have anything you need fixed? I'm gathering a list of items people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, just heard the repair drive is this Saturday at Eli's garage on Oak Street, starting at 9!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Saturday at 9? At Eli's garage? I think I remember something about that. I'll try to be there, unless I get sidetracked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, hope you can make it! I'll be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! Just a reminder, the repair drive is tomorrow at 9 AM at 42 Cherry Lane. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was at the community center on Elm Street, not Cherry Lane. Are you sure about the location?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm sure—it's definitely 42 Cherry Lane. The flyer had that address.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I don't know, Oren. I haven't seen any flyers. Are you sure it's this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so... It's for old appliances, right? Near the playground Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought it was at the community center from 10 to 4, not near the playground at 9. Are you sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? It's at 42 Cherry Lane from 9 to 4!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's the old info! It's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center from 10 to 2. Could you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa! I'll make sure to tell everyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's this Saturday from 9 AM to 4 PM at the community center on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the community center! I thought it was near the playground. I'll bring my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, bring it along! We could use more tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure we have everything ready yet. Are we still waiting on those parts?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a bunch of tools in my shed if you need anything—just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's thoughtful, Gus. I still think we need to double-check the list of required items before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira, I've got my spare parts box all packed and ready for the repair drive this weekend!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, Cleo! Don't forget, it's at Eli's garage, 123 Oak Street, starting at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the reminder, Ira! I'll be there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Do you think you could come by?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, actually it's at 42 Cherry Lane, not the community center. But yes, I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the correction, Mara! I'll make sure to update everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, I heard you might need help with the repair drive. It's Sunday at the community center, right? Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought it was Saturday at 9 AM? Maybe I'm mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No, it's definitely Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM. I just checked the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a community event this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4, where we fix broken items together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, I thought it was Sunday from 10 to 2? Did the date change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, I heard the repair drive is at 123 Oak Street starting at 9 AM this Saturday. Do you know what we're fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: People usually bring broken electronics, small appliances, and furniture. It's a community effort to fix things together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So it's general community repairs? I thought I heard it was specifically for the school's router. Can you clarify?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think it's a car repair thing at Leo's this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, Bo, it's not car repair—it's a drive to fix the school's router this Saturday at 9 AM at 123 Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the router thing. Got it, Saturday at 9 at 123 Oak. I'll probably be tied up, but good luck with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive this Saturday? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't seen any flyers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's definitely happening, Kira! I've been telling everyone myself. No flyers yet, but we're spreading the word through the grapevine.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hmm, through the grapevine? I guess I'll believe it when I see a flyer or a sign.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, so it's a place where people can fix broken things together? That sounds really community-oriented.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I suppose so. I just haven't had the headspace for community stuff lately.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I get that. It can be a lot sometimes. But if you ever want to drop by, I think it's on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, the repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM near the playground. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Actually, it's at my garage, not the playground. I'm collecting items there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, really? I must have mixed it up. Thanks for setting that straight, Leo! I'll make sure to head to your garage instead.
